title: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 872, who is the young
question:
For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 872, who is the youngest?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: race number refers to raceId; drivers who finished the race refers to time has value; the youngest is a driver where MAX(dob);

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
WHERE r.XCL_074 = 872
  AND r.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
  AND r.XCL_084 != ''
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1;
